items.name: Bekkeblom
items.reviewNotes: Large glossy kidney- to heart-shaped leaves with rounded toothed margins, hairless fleshy stems, clustered rounded golden blooms with five petal-like sepals, central stamens and basal fibrous roots. Golden parts are SEPALS rather than petals. Image is a drawn field guide, not independent evidence of identification; vegetative details cannot diagnose all regional variants.
